
{{alias}}( [options] )
    Returns an autosize instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    options.contains: string (optional)
        Method for determining how a size calculation should be performed.
        Default: 'content'.

    options.resize: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to re-calculate an autosize layout on every
        view update. Default: false.

    options.type: string (optional)
        Autosize method. Default: 'pad'.

    Returns
    -------
    autosize: Autosize
        Autosize instance.

    autosize.contains
        Method for determining how a size calculation should be performed.

    autosize.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    autosize.resize
        Boolean indicating whether to re-calculate an autosize layout on every
        view update.

    autosize.type
        Autosize type.

    autosize.toJSON()
        Serializes an autosize instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var autosize = new {{alias}}()
    <Autosize>

    // Provide options at instantiation:
    > autosize = new {{alias}}( { 'type': 'fit', 'resize': true } )
    <Autosize>
    > autosize.type
    'fit'

    // Set a property:
    > autosize.contains = 'padding';
    > autosize.contains
    'padding'

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > autosize.toJSON()
    { 'contains': 'padding', 'resize': true, 'type': 'fit' }

    See Also
    --------
